articles.headline: Feyenoord beat PSV Eindhoven in Dutch season curtain-raiser
articles.description: Cup winners Feyenoord edged league champions PSV Eindhoven on penalties at the end of an eight-goal stalemate in the Johan Cruyff Shield, as the new Dutch season got off to a rollicking start on Sunday.

images.name: PSV Eindhoven Feyenoord [1296x729]
images.credit: Marcel van Dorst/NurPhoto via Getty Images

articles.headline: PSV Eindhoven beat Feyenoord to win 3rd straight Dutch Super Cup
articles.description: New signing Noa Lang swept home the ball at the end of a flowing attack to hand PSV Eindhoven a 1-0 win over Eredivisie champions Feyenoord in Friday's Dutch Super Cup.

images.name: PSV lift Dutch Super Cup [1296x729]
images.caption: PSV Eindhoven lift the Johan Cruyff Shield for the third successive season.

articles.headline: PSV Eindhoven beat Ajax in Johan Cruyff Shield thriller thanks to Guus Til debut hat trick
articles.description: PSV Eindhoven debutant Guus Til scored a hat-trick as they beat hosts Ajax Amsterdam 5-3 in a thrilling Johan Cruyff Shield match on Saturday.

images.name: PSV celeb vs. Ajax_20220730 [1296x729]
images.caption: Guus Til celebrates one of his three goals for PSV Eindhoven in their 4-3 win over Ajax in the Dutch Johan Cruyff Shield.

articles.headline: Ajax knock off PSV to win 9th Johan Cruyff Shield
articles.description: Ajax Amsterdam beat PSV Eindhoven 2-0 on Saturday to win their ninth Dutch Johan Cruyff Shield.

images.name: Ajax celeb vs PSV Dutch Cup 190727 [1296x729]
images.caption: Ajax players celebrate after a Daley Blind goal against PSV in the Dutch Johan Cruyff Shield.
images.alt: Ajax players celebrate after a Daley Blind goal against PSV in the Dutch Johan Cruyff Shield.
